source.name: MS-ASL
source.citation: Vaezi Joze, H. and Koller, O. (2019). MS-ASL: A Large-Scale Data Set and Benchmark for Understanding American Sign Language.
source.important: This curriculum is for research and computational use only. Review the C-UDA before training, publishing, redistributing clips, or using it commercially.

intermediate.title: Intermediate Conversational Fluency
intermediate.description: Word-level building blocks for conversational ASL. MS-ASL is an isolated-sign dataset, so it does not train sentence translation.

professional.title: Professional & Workplace Communication
professional.description: Workplace vocabulary for ASL practice. These are individual signs, not a substitute for qualified workplace interpretation.
